---
title: Marketplace bundles
description: How templates and evidence adapters are installed today — no atomic bundle rollback.
---

Older docs described **marketplace bundles**: one-click packs that installed a workflow template, several extensions, and rolled back atomically if any step failed. That product surface was never shipped as described.

## What exists today

Onboarding is two separate flows:

1. **Template gallery** — when you create a workspace, pick **Copy from Template** in the new-workspace wizard. Kiket scaffolds a repo from a GitHub template or copies `.kiket/` from a curated pack. See [Templates](/docs/build/templates) and [Definition packs](/docs/build/definition-packs).
2. **Evidence adapters** — install connectors one at a time from **Settings → Evidence sources** (or the public marketplace catalog). Each adapter registers ingress, optional credentials, and event sources. See [Integrations overview](/docs/integrations/overview).

There is **no** single "bundle install" transaction, **no** automatic rollback across template + adapter steps, and **no** guaranteed all-or-nothing state if one adapter fails mid-setup.

## Recommended path

<Steps>

<Step>

### Start from a template or definition pack

Use the template gallery at workspace creation, or copy a flagship pack into your repo under `.kiket/`. You get workflows, case types, checks, and simulations without installing every connector upfront.

</Step>

<Step>

### Connect evidence sources as you need them

Open **Settings → Evidence sources** and install adapters (GitHub, Slack, generic webhook, Jira, ServiceNow, or published marketplace listings). Configure credentials and webhook URLs per adapter — installs are independent.

</Step>

<Step>

### Validate in the Modeling Cockpit

Before going live, run impact checks and YAML regression tests in the editor. See [Simulation cockpit](/docs/compliance/simulation-cockpit).

</Step>

</Steps>

## Legacy bundle table (archived)

The table below reflected pre-launch planning fiction. Do not rely on these bundle IDs or atomic install behavior.

| Planned bundle | Intended contents | Status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| DevOps Starter | Kanban + GitHub + Slack | Use [Templates](/docs/build/templates) + GitHub/Slack adapters separately |
| GDPR Compliance Pack | Privacy workflow + email | Use [Definition packs](/docs/build/definition-packs) privacy pack + adapters |
| Enterprise Security | Contract review + Jira | Template + Jira adapter |
| Others | Multi-workflow "suites" | Not shipped as unified bundles |

## What's next

Curated **starter sets** (template + recommended adapters as documentation, not a single install button) may return on the roadmap. Until then, treat templates and evidence adapters as composable pieces you install and configure explicitly.
